phoneticConvention: Approximate English respelling for English-speaking readers (CAPITALS = stressed syllable; vowels ah / eh / ee / oh / oo; j and g before e/i → kh as in Scottish 'loch'; ñ → ny; ll → y; c before e/i and z → s; r is rolled; monosyllables in capitals). Standard Castilian with seseo and yeísmo. No substitute for the audio.
reviewStatus: Written by rule from validated content; native English review recommended.
title: Telling what happened
goal: Tell about a past event and ask for news.

model.note: Pretérito indefinido (simple past) for a single, completed event.

variants.native: Yesterday I had lunch with my parents.
Yesterday I didn't leave the house.

model.note: 'Fui' is the same whether a man or a woman is speaking.

variants.native: I went to the cinema with Ana.

variants.study: La semana pasada estuve en Madrid.
variants.phon: LAH seh-MAH-nah pah-SAH-dah ehs-TOO-veh EHN mah-DREED
variants.native: Last week I was in Madrid.

variants.study: Hace dos días estuve en Madrid.
variants.phon: AH-seh DOHS DEE-ahs ehs-TOO-veh EHN mah-DREED
variants.native: Two days ago I was in Madrid.

variants.study: El mes pasado estuve en Madrid.
variants.phon: EHL MEHS pah-SAH-doh ehs-TOO-veh EHN mah-DREED
variants.native: Last month I was in Madrid.

variants.study: El año pasado estuve en Madrid.
variants.phon: EHL AH-nyoh pah-SAH-doh ehs-TOO-veh EHN mah-DREED
variants.native: Last year I was in Madrid.

model.note: Set phrases to learn as they are.

slot.phon: KEH TAHL EHL FEEN DEH seh-MAH-nah

variants.phon: KEH TAHL EHL FEEN DEH seh-MAH-nah

model.note: Short reactions to learn as they are.

model.study: Primero {s} y luego fuimos a cenar.
model.phon: pree-MEH-roh {s} EE LOOEH-goh FOOEE-mohs AH seh-NAHR
model.native: First {s} and then we went for dinner.

variants.study: Primero visitamos el museo y luego fuimos a cenar.
variants.phon: pree-MEH-roh vee-see-TAH-mohs EHL moo-SEH-oh EE LOOEH-goh FOOEE-mohs AH seh-NAHR
variants.native: First we visited the museum and then we went for dinner.

variants.study: Primero dimos un paseo y luego fuimos a cenar.
variants.phon: pree-MEH-roh DEE-mohs OON pah-SEH-oh EE LOOEH-goh FOOEE-mohs AH seh-NAHR
variants.native: First we went for a walk and then we went for dinner.

variants.study: Primero tomamos algo y luego fuimos a cenar.
variants.phon: pree-MEH-roh toh-MAH-mohs AHL-goh EE LOOEH-goh FOOEE-mohs AH seh-NAHR
variants.native: First we had a drink and then we went for dinner.

variants.study: Primero fuimos de compras y luego fuimos a cenar.
variants.phon: pree-MEH-roh FOOEE-mohs DEH KOHM-prahs EE LOOEH-goh FOOEE-mohs AH seh-NAHR
variants.native: First we went shopping and then we went for dinner.

variants.study: En las vacaciones viajamos a Portugal.
variants.phon: EHN LAHS vah-kah-SEEOH-nehs veeah-KHAH-mohs AH pohr-too-GAHL
variants.native: On holiday we travelled to Portugal.
On holiday I rested a lot.

variants.study: En las vacaciones conocí a gente nueva.
variants.phon: EHN LAHS vah-kah-SEEOH-nehs koh-noh-SEE AH KHEHN-teh NOOEH-vah
variants.native: On holiday I met new people.

variants.study: En las vacaciones hizo muy buen tiempo.
variants.phon: EHN LAHS vah-kah-SEEOH-nehs EE-soh MOOEE BOOEHN TEEEHM-poh
variants.native: On holiday the weather was lovely.

units.situation: Asking what the other person did

variants.phon: KEH ee-SEES-teh EHL FEEN DEH seh-MAH-nah
variants.native: What did you do at the weekend?
What did you do last night?
What did you do at Christmas?

units.situation: Talking about your morning at work

variants.study: Esta mañana llegué tarde al trabajo.
variants.phon: EHS-tah mah-NYAH-nah yeh-KHEH TAHR-deh AHL trah-BAH-khoh
variants.native: This morning I got to work late.
This morning I had a meeting.
This morning I missed the bus.

variants.study: Esta mañana hablé con el jefe.
variants.phon: EHS-tah mah-NYAH-nah ah-BLEH KOHN EHL KHEH-feh
variants.native: This morning I spoke to the boss.

turns.speaker: A
turns.phon: OH-lah, PAH-bloh. KEH TAHL
turns.native: Hi, Pablo! How's it going?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Muy bien, ¿y tú? ¿Qué hay de nuevo?
turns.phon: MOOEE BEEEHN, EE TOO. KEH AHEE DEH NOOEH-voh
turns.native: Very well, and you? What's new?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: El fin de semana fui a Barcelona.
turns.phon: EHL FEEN DEH seh-MAH-nah FOOEE AH bahr-seh-LOH-nah
turns.native: At the weekend I went to Barcelona.

turns.speaker: B
turns.phon: DEH vehr-DAHD. KEH ee-SEES-teh
turns.native: Really? What did you do?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Primero visité la Sagrada Familia y luego fui a la playa.
turns.phon: pree-MEH-roh vee-see-TEH LAH sah-GRAH-dah fah-MEE-leeah EE LOOEH-goh FOOEE AH LAH PLAH-yah
turns.native: First I visited the Sagrada Familia and then I went to the beach.

turns.speaker: B
turns.phon: KEH BEEEHN. TEH goos-TOH LAH seeoo-DAHD
turns.native: Great! Did you like the city?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Sí, me encantó. ¿Y tú, qué hiciste?
turns.phon: SEE, MEH ehn-kahn-TOH. EE TOO, KEH ee-SEES-teh
turns.native: Yes, I loved it. And you, what did you do?

turns.speaker: B
turns.phon: NAH-dah ehs-peh-SEEAHL, dehs-kahn-SEH EHN KAH-sah
turns.native: Nothing special, I rested at home.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Buenos días. ¿Qué tal el fin de semana?
turns.phon: BOOEH-nohs DEE-ahs. KEH TAHL EHL FEEN DEH seh-MAH-nah
turns.native: Good morning. How was your weekend?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Regular. El sábado trabajé y el domingo llovió.
turns.phon: reh-goo-LAHR. EHL SAH-bah-doh trah-bah-KHEH EE EHL doh-MEEN-goh yoh-VEEOH
turns.native: So-so. On Saturday I worked and on Sunday it rained.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: ¡Qué pena! Yo comí con mis padres y después vimos una película.
turns.phon: KEH PEH-nah. YOH koh-MEE KOHN MEES PAH-drehs EE dehs-POOEHS VEE-mohs OO-nah peh-LEE-koo-lah
turns.native: What a shame! I had lunch with my parents and afterwards we watched a film.

turns.speaker: B
turns.phon: KOOAHL
turns.native: Which one?

turns.speaker: A
turns.phon: OO-nah koh-MEH-deeah ehs-pah-NYOH-lah. MOOEE dee-vehr-TEE-dah
turns.native: A Spanish comedy. Very funny.

turns.speaker: B
turns.phon: KOH-moh SEH YAH-mah
turns.native: What's it called?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: No me acuerdo. Te lo digo luego.
turns.phon: NOH MEH ah-KOOEHR-doh. TEH LOH DEE-goh LOOEH-goh
turns.native: I don't remember. I'll tell you later.

turns.speaker: B
turns.phon: VAH-leh, LAH VEH-oh EHS-tah seh-MAH-nah
turns.native: OK, I'll watch it this week.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

turns.speaker: A
turns.phon: OH-lah, mah-MAH. KOH-moh ehs-TAHS
turns.native: Hi, Mum. How are you?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Bien, cansada. Ayer fui al médico.
turns.phon: BEEEHN, kahn-SAH-dah. ah-YEHR FOOEE AHL MEH-dee-koh
turns.native: Fine, tired. Yesterday I went to the doctor.

turns.speaker: A
turns.phon: EE KEH TEH DEE-khoh
turns.native: And what did he say?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Nada grave. Y tú, ¿qué tal el trabajo?
turns.phon: NAH-dah GRAH-veh. EE TOO, KEH TAHL EHL trah-BAH-khoh
turns.native: Nothing serious. And you, how's work?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Esta mañana tuve una reunión y llegué tarde.
turns.phon: EHS-tah mah-NYAH-nah TOO-veh OO-nah rehoo-NEEOHN EE yeh-KHEH TAHR-deh
turns.native: This morning I had a meeting and I got there late.

turns.speaker: B
turns.phon: POHR KEH
turns.native: Why?

turns.speaker: A
turns.phon: pehr-DEE EHL ahoo-toh-BOOS
turns.native: I missed the bus.

turns.speaker: B
turns.phon: NOH MEH DEE-gahs. VEEEH-nehs EHL doh-MEEN-goh
turns.native: No way! Are you coming on Sunday?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Sí, voy a comer con vosotros.
turns.phon: SEE, VOHEE AH koh-MEHR KOHN voh-SOH-trohs
turns.native: Yes, I'm coming to have lunch with you.

turns.speaker: B
turns.phon: KEH BEEEHN. AHS-tah EHL doh-MEEN-goh
turns.native: Great! See you on Sunday.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

readiness: Say what you did (yesterday, at the weekend, on holiday) in the simple past (pretérito indefinido), place events in the past, link actions (primero, luego, después), ask how things are and react.
